## NoteLink 0.3.0

> **Tag:** [`notelink-v0.3.0`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/releases/tag/notelink-v0.3.0) · **Date:** 2026-11-04 · **Since:** [`notelink-v0.2.6`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/releases/tag/notelink-v0.2.6) · **8 commits** (5 features, 3 maintenance) · [Full Diff](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/compare/notelink-v0.2.6...notelink-v0.3.0)

**Release Summary:** new transfer protocol support

### Features

- **phone-desktop**: NoteLink v4 host with LAN-only mode ([`0e05388`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/0e053887b64c2e30f4f181f0118c97c04920dda4))
  - The desktop answers v4 over BLE when available and always over LAN (UDP 39818 discovery, TCP 39817 control), so a PC without Bluetooth can pair and transfer. Orphaned queue items are re-targeted to the paired Note on start and after pairing. The firewall script opens UDP 39818.
- **phone-app**: NoteLink v4 host with code-entry pairing ([`3125184`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/31251849aacd0752fc6d90701070194ecb466e21))
  - PhoneCommandProcessor implements NoteLinkHost (queue, export inbox, APK update, P2P). Pairing asks for the code shown on the Note. Items queued for a Note that is no longer paired are adopted on the next pairing.
- **transfer-windows**: per-client GATT events and multi-adapter LAN info ([`de5d3b1`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/de5d3b1d0927bcf16b6fe597eeb96ee630fa5f50))
  - nl_ble_poll_event/nl_ble_notify bridge per-subscriber records, MTU and connect events to Kotlin. nl_lan_info returns every Wi-Fi and Ethernet IPv4 address. Globals are guarded by the mutex.
- **transfer-android**: serialized GATT client and v4 BLE peripheral ([`23d4f3c`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/23d4f3c31ac3443fd81caa77a4b227fe8943f5e0))
  - BleProtocolClient waits for every GATT callback (connect, MTU, discovery, CCCD, writes). The peripheral uses an AdvertisingSet updated in place and a pairing flag. Wi-Fi Direct joins with known credentials directly, and the network provider reports Wi-Fi/Ethernet LAN addresses.
- **transfer-core**: NoteLink v4 protocol over BLE and LAN ([`feac6dc`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/feac6dc78789da3ecf44029e605e97f55d9e8695))
  - Protobuf v4 schema with SRP-6a pairing, a one-RTT PSK handshake and per-link ciphers. PeerConnection multiplexes exchanges over BLE, LAN and P2P links with keepalive. NoteLinkServer/NoteLinkClient implement fetch, lease, export push and APK update; LAN control works without Bluetooth through UDP discovery (39818) plus TCP (39817). The v3 BLE queue protocol is removed.

<details>
<summary>Build, CI &amp; Maintenance (3 commits)</summary>

- **style**: format Kotlin code and fix lint issues ([`965b426`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/965b4262391cef14027df097c9be1ca3e08258af))
  - Adjust line wrapping, indentation, and trailing commas
  - Declare network state permission and annotate the Bluetooth callback
  - Use KTX edit for SharedPreferences updates
  - Remove a redundant Android version check
- **build**: add the protobuf plugin and a buf lint job for the v4 schema ([`20c30b9`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/20c30b9b3584b9cf2b57c1dd53833d44495b8b19))
- **docs**: document the toolbar catalog, e-ink layer and export changes ([`80ed442`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/80ed442bd61de1bfc738693cad405f6f0d5e52bd))
  - Record the toolbar/UI architecture rules: catalog registration, scoped EinkTheme and ToolbarEffect handling.
  - Update the export section for fast raster mode, shared page cache keys, run reports, progress reporting and the v9 schema.

</details>

## BetterHvNote 0.3.0

> **Tag:** [`note-v0.3.0`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/releases/tag/note-v0.3.0) · **Date:** 2026-11-04 · **Since:** [`note-v0.2.2`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/releases/tag/note-v0.2.2) · **12 commits** (8 features, 1 fix, 3 maintenance) · [Full Diff](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/compare/note-v0.2.2...note-v0.3.0)

**Release Summary:** new transfer protocol support

### Features

- **app**: warm NoteLink v4 sessions and multi-NoteLink insert ([`872bf11`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/872bf11a72dc59fdf11f3dbf7efa21b59dcc8bb0))
  - NoteLinkConnections keeps one session per paired NoteLink, racing LAN against BLE. Insert waits until every paired NoteLink has reported its counts, so the chooser appears when several have content. The chooser and settings show the control mode after the name.
- **transfer-android**: serialized GATT client and v4 BLE peripheral ([`23d4f3c`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/23d4f3c31ac3443fd81caa77a4b227fe8943f5e0))
  - BleProtocolClient waits for every GATT callback (connect, MTU, discovery, CCCD, writes). The peripheral uses an AdvertisingSet updated in place and a pairing flag. Wi-Fi Direct joins with known credentials directly, and the network provider reports Wi-Fi/Ethernet LAN addresses.
- **transfer-core**: NoteLink v4 protocol over BLE and LAN ([`feac6dc`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/feac6dc78789da3ecf44029e605e97f55d9e8695))
  - Protobuf v4 schema with SRP-6a pairing, a one-RTT PSK handshake and per-link ciphers. PeerConnection multiplexes exchanges over BLE, LAN and P2P links with keepalive. NoteLinkServer/NoteLinkClient implement fetch, lease, export push and APK update; LAN control works without Bluetooth through UDP discovery (39818) plus TCP (39817). The v3 BLE queue protocol is removed.
- **ui**: apply the e-ink theme to page, notebook and backup surfaces ([`f03670a`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/f03670ac9477689cd92f58438ded3e08be21e814))
  - Use the shared tokens and components in the hardware binding panel, notebook manager, page manager, page selection grid, notebook name dialog and backup screen.
  - Replace the remaining Material defaults (light grey selection, rounded buttons, RadioButton) with the 1 dp black-bordered e-ink chrome.
- **toolbar**: drive the toolbar from a command catalog ([`d7e745e`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/d7e745e8b0f56ab961508e64bdee1f255639a7cf))
  - Replace CommandRegistry.toolbar and MainActivity's per-tool when branches with ToolbarCatalog, ToolbarTool and pure ToolbarEffect values.
  - Dispatch commands through ToolbarCommandRouter and apply the effects in the app root through ToolEffectSink.
  - Derive the settings toolbar-visibility list, command titles and K1-K8 bindings from the catalog instead of a parallel list.
  - Move ToolKind and EraserMode into EditorModes, keep item labels in the tool model and drop the ToolbarItem label/localizedLabel duplication.
  - Restyle the settings page and its toolbar list on the shared e-ink components, and add unit and instrumented coverage for the catalog, the effects and the settings chrome.
- **export**: add fast raster pages, run reports and progress ([`ad77353`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/ad77353c0738ea6a0f77c9af214d4b31631fd6ce))
  - Add ExportRenderMode with an opt-in fast mode that rasterizes each page once at 2x under an 8 MP / 8192 px cap and embeds it as one image.
  - Share page files between tasks through ExportPageCacheKey and publish a single-page PDF task's page file directly instead of merging.
  - Write a structured run report per task (mode, cache hits, stage timings, bytes, result) and surface it in the task info dialog.
  - Report elapsed time, ETA and throttled page progress through ExportProgressSink, and keep "cancelling" visible while a native PDF save blocks.
  - Composite PNG output from the MuPDF background plus ink, and keep one editable ink annotation per stroke in vector mode.
  - Add JVM and instrumented coverage for cache keys, raster limits, reports, fast pages, cancellation and cross-task cache reuse.
- **storage**: add the v9 export render mode column ([`e565ba2`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/e565ba26519b7303a18562a0d1e25729a7dd2c2f))
  - Bump the schema to v9 and add export_tasks.render_mode, defaulting to the editable vector ink of older tasks.
  - Migrate v8 databases in place and create the column for new databases.
  - Keep the v7 backup staging test on MigrationManager.VERSION and simulate a task table that predates the column.
- **ui**: add the shared e-ink design system ([`b6aedba`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/b6aedba49c87a75dde60ebb33f6808a19991e940))
  - Define the monochrome colours, hairline borders, 44 dp touch targets and typography roles in EinkTokens.
  - Add EinkTheme plus the shared toolbar, panel and progress components built from those tokens.
  - Move the modal overlay and its actions onto the same tokens, with an adjustable border width for dialogs that need emphasis.
  - Cover the token contract with JVM tests.

### Bug Fixes

- **backup**: drop stale export reports when restoring ([`8878c53`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/8878c534f2e2e69519f4318136f1e40dcc063548))
  - Restored documents no longer correspond to the run reports left by the previous database, so delete files/exports/reports together with the other export caches.

## BetterHvNote 0.2.2

> **Tag:** [`note-v0.2.2`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/releases/tag/note-v0.2.2) · **Date:** 2026-10-26 · **Since:** [`note-v0.2.1`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/releases/tag/note-v0.2.1) · **7 commits** (3 features, 4 maintenance) · [Full Diff](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/compare/note-v0.2.1...note-v0.2.2)

**Release Summary:** commands, tail eraser, backup and hardware bindings

### Features

- **tablet**: add app commands, tail eraser, backup and hardware bindings ([`054b2fe`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/054b2fe1f1783e9da017b541fc9a2d0c5a42c82f))
  - Introduce a command registry and hardware shortcut bindings.
  - Support tail eraser selection and clipboard insertion.
  - Add notebook backup archives, restore UI and backup tests.
  - Refresh the editor, page manager, toolbar and settings surfaces.
- **notelink**: add share intake, history, firewall and stable BLE pairing ([`5d5e5fe`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/5d5e5fe2be8891117627e4cac1f20ff0aea51613))
  - Sniff and import supported shared files individually on Android.
  - Keep send history with payload retention on Android and Windows.
  - Add queue/stack ordering, Windows single-instance handoff and firewall diagnostics.
  - Keep BLE advertising stable across service restarts and allow authenticated LAN when the SSID is unknown.
  - Make the desktop dashboard scroll as a single page.
- **transfer-core**: add content sniffing, send history and queue ordering ([`a5fc8d8`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/a5fc8d80fe5aa6ff11d0bc6df0c8dd71c788b9c9))
  - Sniff shared content by magic bytes, extension and declared MIME.
  - Persist send history with retention and crash reconciliation.
  - Apply queue/stack send order through QueueStore.next.
  - Allow authenticated LAN when the SSID fingerprint is unknown.

## BetterHvNote 0.2.0

> **Tag:** [`note-v0.2.0`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/releases/tag/note-v0.2.0) · **Date:** 2026-09-09 · **Since:** [`note-v0.1.0`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/releases/tag/note-v0.1.0) · **7 commits** (3 features, 4 maintenance) · [Full Diff](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/compare/note-v0.1.0...note-v0.2.0)

**Release Summary:** bug fixes and pen engine update

fixs:
- (export) export will run automatically
- (export) share button will detect online notelink itself
- (template) template selection in note creating page now use the right
  size
- (media insert) `pull from notelink as long as avaliable` works as
  expected

feat:
rewrite pen engine, now the default pen has the same appearance as the live ink provided by Hanvon.
also remove pressure from the other two pen type.

### Features

- **export**: queue jobs with diagnostics and retry controls ([`97e0d12`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/97e0d12ff633c4bf7eb6a32a2a5b4b201fead269))
  - Run export generation through a cancellable queue, report stage-specific progress and outcomes, retain detailed failure diagnostics, and expose explicit generate, retry, and cancel actions.
  - Discover NoteLink clients at send time with permission handling, serialize the latest notebook state before export, and add JVM plus device workflow coverage.
- **editor**: streamline insertion and in-app feedback ([`06d2358`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/06d2358d986a1237bde7ad6a612a2739132d22f8))
  - Route image and text insertion through one automatic source decision, preserve explicit local and NoteLink choices, and cover permission-aware entry behavior.
  - Replace snackbars and the dedicated update banner with reusable e-ink notifications. Validate new-notebook canvas and template compatibility before creation and surface creation failures.
- **ink**: align strokes with ROM width geometry ([`a1e6e42`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/a1e6e42f869284d2519d1077a042a865b5ebb39b))
  - Treat the vendor callback scalar as a normalized stroke-width ratio, keep pen configuration stable for each gesture, and use transactional stroke modeling with whole-stroke raw fallback.
  - Render the same swept-disc geometry in the editor, thumbnails, eraser hit testing, and PDF exports. Add pressure diagnostics, parity artifacts, and regression coverage for modeling, persistence, and geometry.

- **fix(ci)**: remove references to deleted script tests ([`48a1358`](https://github.com/zentialEdwardSu/betterhvnote/commit/48a13581683fffd09fc6e4b25a2da0ca6c8bb517))
